summary: Agreement to sell vs specific performance; Power of Attorney validity; co-owners' consent; limitation period; non-appearance of plaintiff as witness; endorsement extensions; coparcenary property without all heirs' signatures; Shanmughasundaram precedent applied; trial court decree reversed by High Court on dual grounds; failure to produce Power of Attorney document; testimony sufficiency of Attorney Holder; specific performance refused due to incomplete co-owner signatures; High Court judgment upheld on appeal.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment allowing defendant appeal and setting aside Trial Court decree upheld; specific performance denied due to incomplete co-owner signatures on agreement.
